title: The Moss Grave
text: A grave so overgrown with moss that it has become a hill, soft and green and humming with insects. A sword hilt pokes out of the top, its pommel a silver lion's head. The moss around it has been worn away, as if hands have tugged at it.

options.label: Dig for the sword. Someone has already tried, and failed.

outcomes.text: The sword, and the old bones politely still, and the moss whispering about it after.

options.label: The devout prays over the grave, for whoever lies beneath.

outcomes.text: Something old beneath the moss is grateful, and its courage settles on them.

options.label: Mark the grave, and leave it to its moss.

outcomes.text: A grave is a grave. Those who come after will see you honored it.
